components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action of a surface: cutter yellow with dark ink.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 4v11M7.5 10.5 12 15l4.5-4.5"/><path d="M4.5 15.5v2.5a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h11a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-2.5"/></svg>Unduh</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent, oklch(81% 0.155 80)); color: var(--accent-ink, oklch(21% 0.01 80)); font: 500 0.8125rem/1.25rem Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, oklch(86% 0.14 86)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, oklch(85% 0.135 84)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A second action: hover film with an inset control edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--hover, oklch(98% 0.003 80 / 0.07)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-strong, oklch(41% 0.004 80)); color: var(--ink, oklch(94.5% 0.003 80)); font: 500 0.8125rem/1.25rem Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--line, oklch(32% 0.003 80)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, oklch(85% 0.135 84)); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Text action with no fill until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, oklch(74% 0.004 80)); font: 400 0.8125rem/1.25rem Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--hover, oklch(98% 0.003 80 / 0.07)); color: var(--ink, oklch(94.5% 0.003 80)); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, oklch(85% 0.135 84)); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Field on dark surfaces; yellow stroke and ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, oklch(41% 0.004 80)); border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(20.5% 0.002 80 / 0.6); color: var(--ink, oklch(94.5% 0.003 80)); font: 400 0.8125rem/1.25rem Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--faint, oklch(66.5% 0.004 80)); } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, oklch(81% 0.155 80)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, oklch(81% 0.155 80)); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Mode and option picker; the on segment is raised and ringed.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(20.5% 0.002 80 / 0.6); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line, oklch(32% 0.003 80)); } .ds-seg-item { height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, oklch(74% 0.004 80)); font: 500 0.75rem/1rem Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-seg-item:hover { color: var(--ink, oklch(94.5% 0.003 80)); } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, oklch(85% 0.135 84)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-seg-on { background: var(--raised, oklch(28.5% 0.003 80)); color: var(--ink, oklch(94.5% 0.003 80)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line-strong, oklch(41% 0.004 80)); }

components.name: Rail Tool
components.description: An editor tool on the rail: icon over a condensed caption; active in yellow.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 6px; background: var(--panel, oklch(23.5% 0.002 80)); } .ds-rail-btn { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: 60px; padding: 8px 2px 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, oklch(74% 0.004 80)); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-rail-btn span { font: 500 0.6875rem/0.8125rem Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: "wdth" 78; } .ds-rail-btn:hover { background: var(--hover, oklch(98% 0.003 80 / 0.07)); color: var(--ink, oklch(94.5% 0.003 80)); } .ds-rail-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, oklch(85% 0.135 84)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-rail-on, .ds-rail-on:hover { background: oklch(81% 0.155 80 / 0.15); color: var(--accent-text, oklch(85% 0.135 84)); }

components.name: Menu
components.description: Raised floating panel with ring-plus-shadow and 32px items.
components.css: .ds-menu { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 200px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--raised, oklch(28.5% 0.003 80)); color: var(--ink, oklch(94.5% 0.003 80)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line-strong, oklch(41% 0.004 80)), 0 8px 24px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.45); } .ds-menu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: inherit; text-align: left; font: 400 0.8125rem/1.25rem Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-item:hover, .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { background: var(--hover, oklch(98% 0.003 80 / 0.07)); } .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, oklch(85% 0.135 84)); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Tool Tray Link
components.description: A tool on the start page's shelf: icon rises and turns yellow, a yellow underline sweeps under the name.
components.html: Gabung PDF
components.css: .ds-tool { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink, oklch(94.5% 0.003 80)); text-decoration: none; font: 400 0.9375rem/1.5rem Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-tool svg { color: var(--muted, oklch(74% 0.004 80)); transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tool span { padding-bottom: 1px; background: linear-gradient(var(--accent, oklch(81% 0.155 80)), var(--accent, oklch(81% 0.155 80))) left bottom / 0% 1.5px no-repeat; transition: background-size 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tool:hover { background-color: var(--hover, oklch(98% 0.003 80 / 0.07)); } .ds-tool:hover svg { color: var(--accent-text, oklch(85% 0.135 84)); translate: 0 -1px; } .ds-tool:hover span { background-size: 100% 1.5px; } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, oklch(85% 0.135 84)); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: The Sheet
components.description: The blank A4 sheet on the bench where a PDF is dropped; lifts on hover/drag.
components.html: Letakkan PDF di sini
components.css: .ds-bench { padding: 40px; background-color: var(--base, oklch(20.5% 0.002 80)); background-image: linear-gradient(oklch(98% 0 0 / 0.08) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(98% 0 0 / 0.08) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(oklch(98% 0 0 / 0.045) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(98% 0 0 / 0.045) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 120px 120px, 120px 120px, 24px 24px, 24px 24px; } .ds-sheet { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; width: 220px; aspect-ratio: 210 / 297; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper, oklch(100% 0 0)); color: var(--paper-ink, oklch(21% 0.004 80)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.4), 0 18px 40px -18px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.65); transition: translate 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-sheet:hover { translate: 0 -6px; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.3), 0 34px 60px -20px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.7); } .ds-cut { position: absolute; inset: 16px; width: calc(100% - 32px); height: calc(100% - 32px); overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; } .ds-sheet p { margin: 0; font: 600 1.125rem/1.75rem Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: "wdth" 112; letter-spacing: -0.025em; }

narrative.overview:
Edith is a dark graphite workbench. The PDF is a white sheet laid on a gridded cutting surface, with real tools lying around it: a snap-off cutter, a pencil, a binder clip, a steel ruler's edge, and a few pencil marks in chalk. The interface is the bench and the document is the work on it; the bench is quiet, hueless and dense, so the white page is always the brightest thing on screen.

One accent carries the whole system: the cutter's yellow. It fills the single main action of a surface, the logo tile and the cutter's body, marks what is selected or active, and is the colour of every focus ring. Everything else is a step of graphite. Depth is literal: sheets cast a short contact shadow and lift when picked up, floating panels are hairline-ringed with a deep soft shadow.

The type is one family, Archivo, used across its width axis: wide and heavy for headings printed on the bench, normal width for reading, condensed for small labels and tool captions. Geist Mono carries numbers and measures. Motion is physical and plays once: the sheet settles onto the bench, the tools slide into place, pencil marks draw themselves, and on upload the scissors run once round the sheet's cut line.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite surfaces without hue; a higher surface is lighter.
One accent, the cutter's yellow, with dark ink on its fills.
White paper appears only as a document (or the blank sheet that receives one).
A faint square cutting grid, in regions only, fading out towards the edges.
Archivo across its width axis plus Geist Mono for figures.
Edith's own icon set: 24 grid, 1.75 stroke, round ends, documents drawn as the folded-corner sheet.
Drawn props and self-drawing pencil marks as the only decoration; all of it aria-hidden and pointer-transparent.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: The cutter's yellow is the only accent. Each surface has at most one yellow-filled action; everything else that is yellow is a mark of state (active, selected, focused) or a drawn prop.

rules.name: The Hueless Bench Rule
rules.body: Interface surfaces, lines and text sit at chroma 0.004 or below. Drawn props and the mascot may carry their own muted material colours (steel, pencil wood, eraser, hair, skin); the bench itself never does.

rules.name: The Paper Is Paper Rule
rules.body: True white is the document. Do not use it for cards, panels or buttons on the bench.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Archivo's width as much as its weight: wide for headings, normal for text, condensed for labels and captions. Do not add a second display family.

rules.name: The Figures In Mono Rule
rules.body: Numbers that are measures or limits (50 MB, page ranges, hex values) are set in Geist Mono.

rules.name: The Grid Under The Work Rule
rules.body: The cutting grid (24px squares, every fifth line stronger at 120px) appears only where work lies: behind the start-page hero, masked to fade towards the edges, and under the editor's pages. It never fills a whole screen edge to edge on the start page and never sits under text-heavy panels.

rules.name: The Ring Plus Shadow Rule
rules.body: A floating surface on dark is drawn with a hairline ring and a soft shadow together; never a shadow alone, never a hard offset shadow.

dos: Do keep every interface surface on the graphite ramp; step lighter to rise (Bench, Panel, Canvas, Raised).
Do use the cutter's yellow for one filled action per surface, with dark ink on it, and as the colour of active, selected and focused state.
Do draw new icons in Edith's set: 24 grid, 1.75 stroke, round ends, documents as the folded-corner sheet.
Do set headings in wide Archivo, labels and captions in condensed Archivo, and figures in Geist Mono.
Do give floating surfaces the Pop or Modal shadow (hairline ring plus soft shadow).
Do keep decoration drawn, flat, aria-hidden and pointer-transparent, and let it animate once.
Do keep secondary text at Faint or lighter so it holds 4.5:1 on Panel and Raised.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour or tint the graphite surfaces with hue.
Don't use white for anything but paper.
Don't fill a whole screen with the cutting grid; keep it under the work and let it fade.
Don't use hard offset shadows or shadow-only floating panels.
Don't place an uppercase label above a headline as a kicker; labels head lists and groups only.
Don't loop decorative motion; only the drop target's marching cut line runs, and only while a file is held over it.
Don't put the PDF page on anything but white paper; the editor draws on it.
